\"/assets/blog/dynamic-routing/cover.jpg\"\n---\n\n# Vue.js状态管理与Pinia深度解析(3)：实战应用与最佳实践\n\n## 实战应用\n\n### 购物车状态管理\n\n```javascript\n// stores/cart.js\nimport { defineStore } from 'pinia'\nimport { ref, computed } from 'vue'\n\nexport const useCartStore = defineStore('cart', () => {\n  // 状态\n  const items = ref([])\n  const couponCode = ref('')\n  const discount = ref(0)\n  \n  // 计算属性\n  const itemCount = computed(() => \n    items.value.reduce((total, item) => total + item.quantity, 0)\n  )\n  \n  const totalPrice = computed(() => {\n    const subtotal = items.value.reduce((total, item) => {\n      return total + (item.price * item.quantity)\n    }, 0)\n    \n    return Math.max(0, subtotal - discount.value)\n  })\n  \n  const isEmpty = computed(() => items.value.length === 0)\n  \n  const hasCoupon = computed(() => !!couponCode.value)\n  \n  // 方法\n  function addToCart(product, quantity = 1) {\n    const existingItem = items.value.find(item => item.id === product.id)\n    \n    if (existingItem) {\n      existingItem.quantity += quantity\n    } else {\n      items.value.push({\n        ...product,\n        quantity\n      })\n    }\n    \n    // 保存到本地存储\n    saveToLocalStorage()\n  }\n  \n  function removeFromCart(productId) {\n    const index = items.value.findIndex(item => item.id === productId)\n    \n    if (index !== -1) {\n      items.value.splice(index, 1)\n      saveToLocalStorage()\n    }\n  }\n  \n  function updateQuantity(productId, quantity) {\n    if (quantity <= 0) {\n      removeFromCart(productId)\n      return\n    }\n    \n    const item = items.value.find(item => item.id === productId)\n    \n    if (item) {\n      item.quantity = quantity\n      saveToLocalStorage()\n    }\n  }\n  \n  function clearCart() {\n    items.value = []\n    couponCode.value = ''\n    discount.value = 0\n    saveToLocalStorage()\n  }\n  \n  function applyCoupon(code) {\n    // 模拟优惠券验证\n    const coupons = {\n      'SAVE10': 0.1,\n      'SAVE20': 0.2,\n      'SAVE30': 0.3\n    }\n    \n    if (coupons[code]) {\n      couponCode.value = code\n      discount.value = totalPrice.value * coupons[code]\n      saveToLocalStorage()\n      return true\n    }\n    \n    return false\n  }\n  \n  function removeCoupon() {\n    couponCode.value = ''\n    discount.value = 0\n    saveToLocalStorage()\n  }\n  \n  function checkout() {\n    // 模拟结账流程\n    return new Promise((resolve) => {\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        clearCart()\n        resolve({ success: true, orderId: 'ORD-' + Date.now() })\n      }, 1000)\n    })\n  }\n  \n  // 本地存储\n  function saveToLocalStorage() {\n    localStorage.setItem('cart', JSON.stringify({\n      items: items.value,\n      couponCode: couponCode.value,\n      discount: discount.value\n    }))\n  }\n  \n  function loadFromLocalStorage() {\n    const savedCart = localStorage.getItem('cart')\n    \n    if (savedCart) {\n      const cart = JSON.parse(savedCart)\n      items.value = cart.items || []\n      couponCode.value = cart.couponCode || ''\n      discount.value = cart.discount || 0\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // 初始化时加载本地存储\n  loadFromLocalStorage()\n  \n  return {\n    // 状态\n    items,\n    couponCode,\n    discount,\n    \n    // 计算属性\n    itemCount,\n    totalPrice,\n    isEmpty,\n    hasCoupon,\n    \n    // 方法\n    addToCart,\n    removeFromCart,\n    updateQuantity,\n    clearCart,\n    applyCoupon,\n    removeCoupon,\n    checkout\n  }\n})\n```\n\n### 主题状态管理\n\n```javascript\n// stores/theme.js\nimport { defineStore } from 'pinia'\nimport { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue'\n\nexport const useThemeStore = defineStore('theme', () => {\n  // 状态\n  const currentTheme = ref('light')\n  const systemTheme = ref('light')\n  const customColors = ref({})\n  \n  // 预定义主题\n  const themes = {\n    light: {\n      primary: '#1976d2',\n      secondary: '#424242',\n      background: '#ffffff',\n      surface: '#f5f5f5',\n      text: '#212121',\n      textSecondary: '#757575'\n    },\n    dark: {\n      primary: '#90caf9',\n      secondary: '#f48fb1',\n      background: '#121212',\n      surface: '#1e1e1e',\n      text: '#ffffff',\n      textSecondary: '#b0b0b0'\n    },\n    blue: {\n      primary: '#2196f3',\n      secondary: '#ff4081',\n      background: '#f3f8ff',\n      surface: '#e3f2fd',\n      text: '#0d47a1',\n      textSecondary: '#1976d2'\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // 计算属性\n  const isDark = computed(() => currentTheme.value === 'dark')\n  const isLight = computed(() => currentTheme.value === 'light')\n  const theme = computed(() => themes[currentTheme.value] || themes.light)\n  \n  // 合并主题和自定义颜色\n  const mergedTheme = computed(() => ({\n    ...theme.value,\n    ...customColors.value\n  }))\n  \n  // CSS变量\n  const cssVariables = computed(() => {\n    const vars = {}\n    \n    Object.entries(mergedTheme.value).forEach(([key, value]) => {\n      vars[`--theme-${key}`] = value\n    })\n    \n    return vars\n  })\n  \n  // 方法\n  function setTheme(themeName) {\n    if (themes[themeName]) {\n      currentTheme.value = themeName\n      saveToLocalStorage()\n      applyTheme()\n    }\n  }\n  \n  function toggleTheme() {\n    currentTheme.value = currentTheme.value === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light'\n    saveToLocalStorage()\n    applyTheme()\n  }\n  \n  function setCustomColor(property, color) {\n    customColors.value[property] = color\n    saveToLocalStorage()\n    applyTheme()\n  }\n  \n  function resetCustomColors() {\n    customColors.value = {}\n    saveToLocalStorage()\n    applyTheme()\n  }\n  \n  function detectSystemTheme() {\n    if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {\n      systemTheme.value = 'dark'\n    } else {\n      systemTheme.value = 'light'\n    }\n  }\n  \n  function useSystemTheme() {\n    detectSystemTheme()\n    currentTheme.value = systemTheme.value\n    saveToLocalStorage()\n    applyTheme()\n  }\n  \n  // 应用主题到DOM\n  function applyTheme() {\n    // 设置主题类\n    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', currentTheme.value)\n    \n    // 设置CSS变量\n    Object.entries(cssVariables.value).forEach(([property, value]) => {\n      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(property, value)\n    })\n    \n    // 设置meta标签\n    const metaThemeColor = document.querySelector('meta[name=\"theme-color\"]')\n    if (metaThemeColor) {\n      metaThemeColor.setAttribute('content', mergedTheme.value.primary)\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // 本地存储\n  function saveToLocalStorage() {\n    localStorage.setItem('theme', JSON.stringify({\n      currentTheme: currentTheme.value,\n      customColors: customColors.value\n    }))\n  }\n  \n  function loadFromLocalStorage() {\n    const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme')\n    \n    if (savedTheme) {\n      const theme = JSON.parse(savedTheme)\n      currentTheme.value = theme.currentTheme || 'light'\n      customColors.value = theme.customColors || {}\n    } else {\n      // 检测系统主题\n      detectSystemTheme()\n      currentTheme.value = systemTheme.value\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // 监听系统主题变化\n  function watchSystemTheme() {\n    if (window.matchMedia) {\n      const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')\n      \n      mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', (e) => {\n        systemTheme.value = e.matches ? 'dark' : 'light'\n      })\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // 初始化\n  loadFromLocalStorage()\n  watchSystemTheme()\n  applyTheme()\n  \n  return {\n    // 状态\n    currentTheme,\n    systemTheme,\n    customColors,\n    themes,\n    \n    // 计算属性\n    isDark,\n    isLight,\n    theme,\n    mergedTheme,\n    cssVariables,\n    \n    // 方法\n    setTheme,\n    toggleTheme,\n    setCustomColor,\n    resetCustomColors,\n    useSystemTheme\n  }\n})\n```\n\n### 通知状态管理\n\n```javascript\n// stores/notifications.js\nimport { defineStore } from 'pinia'\nimport { ref, computed } from 'vue'\n\nexport const useNotificationsStore = defineStore('notifications', () => {\n  // 状态\n  const notifications = ref([])\n  const maxNotifications = ref(5)\n  \n  // 通知类型\n  const notificationTypes = {\n    success: {\n      icon: 'check-circle',\n      color: '#4caf50',\n      duration: 3000\n    },\n    error: {\n      icon: 'error',\n      color: '#f44336',\n      duration: 5000\n    },\n    warning: {\n      icon: 'warning',\n      color: '#ff9800',\n      duration: 4000\n    },\n    info: {\n      icon: 'info',\n      color: '#2196f3',\n      duration: 3000\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // 计算属性\n  const hasNotifications = computed(() => notifications.value.length > 0)\n  const notificationCount = computed(() => notifications.value.length)\n  \n  // 方法\n  function addNotification(notification) {\n    const id = Date.now() + Math.random()\n    \n    const newNotification = {\n      id,\n      title: notification.title || '',\n      message: notification.message || '',\n      type: notification.type || 'info',\n      duration: notification.duration || notificationTypes[notification.type]?.duration || 3000,\n      dismissible: notification.dismissible !== false,\n      persistent: notification.persistent || false,\n      actions: notification.actions || [],\n      ...notificationTypes[notification.type]\n    }\n    \n    // 如果超过最大通知数量，移除最旧的通知\n    if (notifications.value.length >= maxNotifications.value) {\n      notifications.value.shift()\n    }\n    \n    notifications.value.push(newNotification)\n    \n    // 如果不是持久通知，设置自动移除\n    if (!newNotification.persistent) {\n      setTimeout(() => {\n        removeNotification(id)\n      }, newNotification.duration)\n    }\n    \n    return id\n  }\n  \n  function removeNotification(id) {\n    const index = notifications.value.findIndex(n => n.id === id)\n    \n    if (index !== -1) {\n      notifications.value.splice(index, 1)\n    }\n  }\n  \n  function clearNotifications() {\n    notifications.value = []\n  }\n  \n  // 便捷方法\n  function success(title, message, options = {}) {\n    return addNotification({\n      title,\n      message,\n      type: 'success',\n      ...options\n    })\n  }\n  \n  function error(title, message, options = {}) {\n    return addNotification({\n      title,\n      message,\n      type: 'error',\n      ...options\n    })\n  }\n  \n  function warning(title, message, options = {}) {\n    return addNotification({\n      title,\n      message,\n      type: 'warning',\n      ...options\n    })\n  }\n  \n  function info(title, message, options = {}) {\n    return addNotification({\n      title,\n      message,\n      type: 'info',\n      ...options\n    })\n  }\n  \n  // 带操作的通知\n  function confirm(title, message, onConfirm, onCancel, options = {}) {\n    const id = addNotification({\n      title,\n      message,\n      type: 'warning',\n      persistent: true,\n      actions: [\n        {\n          label: '确认',\n          action: () => {\n            onConfirm()\n            removeNotification(id)\n          },\n          primary: true\n        },\n        {\n          label: '取消',\n          action: () => {\n            if (onCancel) onCancel()\n            removeNotification(id)\n          }\n        }\n      ],\n      ...options\n    })\n    \n    return id\n  }\n  \n  return {\n    // 状态\n    notifications,\n    maxNotifications,\n    notificationTypes,\n    \n    // 计算属性\n    hasNotifications,\n    notificationCount,\n    \n    // 方法\n    addNotification,\n    removeNotification,\n    clearNotifications,\n    success,\n    error,\n    warning,\n    info,\n    confirm\n  }\n})\n```\n\n### 用户状态管理\n\n```javascript\n// stores/user.js\nimport { defineStore } from 'pinia'\nimport { ref, computed } from 'vue'\n\nexport const useUserStore = defineStore('user', () => {\n  // 状态\n  const user = ref(null)\n  const token = ref('')\n  const refreshToken = ref('')\n  const permissions = ref([])\n  const preferences = ref({\n    language: 'zh-CN',\n    timezone: 'Asia/Shanghai',\n    emailNotifications: true,\n    pushNotifications: false\n  })\n  \n  // 计算属性\n  const isLoggedIn = computed(() => !!token.value)\n  const userName = computed(() => user.value?.name || '')\n  const userEmail = computed(() => user.value?.email || '')\n  const userAvatar = computed(() => user.value?.avatar || '')\n  const userRole = computed(() => user.value?.role || 'guest')\n  const hasPermission = computed(() => {\n    return (permission) => permissions.value.includes(permission)\n  })\n  \n  // 方法\n  async function login(credentials) {\n    try {\n      // 模拟API调用\n      const response = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify(credentials)\n      })\n      \n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error('登录失败')\n      }\n      \n      const data = await response.json()\n      \n      user.value = data.user\n      token.value = data.token\n      refreshToken.value = data.refreshToken\n      permissions.value = data.permissions || []\n      \n      // 保存到本地存储\n      saveToLocalStorage()\n      \n      return data\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Login error:', error)\n      throw error\n    }\n  }\n  \n  async function register(userData) {\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch('/api/auth/register', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify(userData)\n      })\n      \n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error('注册失败')\n      }\n      \n      const data = await response.json()\n      \n      user.value = data.user\n      token.value = data.token\n      refreshToken.value = data.refreshToken\n      permissions.value = data.permissions || []\n      \n      // 保存到本地存储\n      saveToLocalStorage()\n      \n      return data\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Register error:', error)\n      throw error\n    }\n  }\n  \n  async function logout() {\n    try {\n      // 通知服务器令牌失效\n      if (token.value) {\n        await fetch('/api/auth/logout', {\n          method: 'POST',\n          headers: {\n            'Authorization': `Bearer ${token.value}`\n          }\n        })\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Logout error:', error)\n    } finally {\n      // 无论服务器响应如何，都清除本地状态\n      clearUserData()\n    }\n  }\n  \n  async function refreshAccessToken() {\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch('/api/auth/refresh', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          refreshToken: refreshToken.value\n        })\n      })\n      \n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error('令牌刷新失败')\n      }\n      \n      const data = await response.json()\n      token.value = data.token\n      \n      // 更新本地存储\n      saveToLocalStorage()\n      \n      return data.token\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Token refresh error:', error)\n      // 刷新失败，清除用户数据\n      clearUserData()\n      throw error\n    }\n  }\n  \n  async function updateProfile(profileData) {\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch('/api/user/profile', {\n        method: 'PUT',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n          'Authorization': `Bearer ${token.value}`\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify(profileData)\n      })\n      \n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error('更新个人资料失败')\n      }\n      \n      const data = await response.json()\n      user.value = { ...user.value, ...data.user }\n      \n      // 更新本地存储\n      saveToLocalStorage()\n      \n      return data.user\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Update profile error:', error)\n      throw error\n    }\n  }\n  \n  async function changePassword(passwordData) {\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch('/api/user/password', {\n        method: 'PUT',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n          'Authorization': `Bearer ${token.value}`\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify(passwordData)\n      })\n      \n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error('修改密码失败')\n      }\n      \n      return true\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Change password error:', error)\n      throw error\n    }\n  }\n  \n  function updatePreferences(newPreferences) {\n    preferences.value = { ...preferences.value, ...newPreferences }\n    saveToLocalStorage()\n  }\n  \n  function clearUserData() {\n    user.value = null\n    token.value = ''\n    refreshToken.value = ''\n    permissions.value = []\n    \n    // 清除本地存储\n    localStorage.removeItem('user')\n  }\n  \n  // 本地存储\n  function saveToLocalStorage() {\n    localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify({\n      user: user.value,\n      token: token.value,\n      refreshToken: refreshToken.value,\n      permissions: permissions.value,\n      preferences: preferences.value\n    }))\n  }\n  \n  function loadFromLocalStorage() {\n    const savedUser = localStorage.getItem('user')\n    \n    if (savedUser) {\n      const userData = JSON.parse(savedUser)\n      user.value = userData.user || null\n      token.value = userData.token || ''\n      refreshToken.value = userData.refreshToken || ''\n      permissions.value = userData.permissions || []\n      preferences.value = userData.preferences || {\n        language: 'zh-CN',\n        timezone: 'Asia/Shanghai',\n        emailNotifications: true,\n        pushNotifications: false\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // 初始化时加载本地存储\n  loadFromLocalStorage()\n  \n  return {\n    // 状态\n    user,\n    token,\n    refreshToken,\n    permissions,\n    preferences,\n    \n    // 计算属性\n    isLoggedIn,\n    userName,\n    userEmail,\n    userAvatar,\n    userRole,\n    hasPermission,\n    \n    // 方法\n    login,\n    register,\n    logout,\n    refreshAccessToken,\n    updateProfile,\n    changePassword,\n    updatePreferences,\n    clearUserData\n  }\n})\n```\n\n## 状态管理最佳实践\n\n### 状态结构设计\n\n良好的状态结构设计是可维护状态管理的基础。\n\n```javascript\n// 好的状态结构设计示例\nexport const useProductStore = defineStore('product', () => {\n  // 状态分类清晰\n  const entities = ref({}) // 以ID为键的实体\n  const ids = ref([]) // ID列表，用于排序\n  const loading = ref(false)\n  const error = ref(null)\n  const pagination = ref({\n    page: 1,\n    limit: 20,\n    total: 0\n  })\n  const filters = ref({\n    category: null,\n    priceRange: null,\n    search: ''\n  })\n  \n  // 计算属性\n  const products = computed(() => \n    ids.value.map(id => entities.value[id]).filter(Boolean)\n  )\n  \n  const hasProducts = computed(() => ids.value.length > 0)\n  const isEmpty = computed(() => ids.value.length === 0)\n  const filteredProducts = computed(() => {\n    let result = products.value\n    \n    if (filters.value.category) {\n      result = result.filter(p => p.category === filters.value.category)\n    }\n    \n    if (filters.value.priceRange) {\n      const [min, max] = filters.value.priceRange\n      result = result.filter(p => p.price >= min && p.price <= max)\n    }\n    \n    if (filters.value.search) {\n      const searchLower = filters.value.search.toLowerCase()\n      result = result.filter(p => \n        p.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||\n        p.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower)\n      )\n    }\n    \n    return result\n  })\n  \n  // 方法\n  async function fetchProducts() {\n    loading.value = true\n    error.value = null\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await fetch('/api/products', {\n        method: 'GET',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n        }\n      })\n      \n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error('获取产品列表失败')\n      }\n      \n      const data = await response.json()\n      \n      // 更新实体\n      data.products.forEach(product => {\n        entities.value[product.id] = product\n      })\n      \n      // 更新ID列表\n      ids.value = data.products.map(p => p.id)\n      \n      // 更新分页信息\n      pagination.value = {\n        ...pagination.value,\n        total: data.total\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      error.value = err.message\n      console.error('Fetch products error:', err)\n    } finally {\n      loading.value = false\n    }\n  }\n  \n  async function fetchProduct(id) {\n    if (entities.value[id]) {\n      return entities.value[id]\n    }\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(`/api/products/${id}`)\n      \n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error('获取产品详情失败')\n      }\n      \n      const product = await response.json()\n      \n      // 更新实体\n      entities.value[product.id] = product\n      \n      // 如果不在列表中，添加到列表\n      if (!ids.value.includes(product.id)) {\n        ids.value.push(product.id)\n      }\n      \n      return product\n    } catch (err) {\n      error.value = err.message\n      console.error('Fetch product error:', err)\n      throw err\n    }\n  }\n  \n  function setFilters(newFilters) {\n    filters.value = { ...filters.value, ...newFilters }\n  }\n  \n  function clearFilters() {\n    filters.value = {\n      category: null,\n      priceRange: null,\n      search: ''\n    }\n  }\n  \n  function setPage(page) {\n    pagination.value.page = page\n    fetchProducts()\n  }\n  \n  return {\n    // 状态\n    entities,\n    ids,\n    loading,\n    error,\n    pagination,\n    filters,\n    \n    // 计算属性\n    products,\n    hasProducts,\n    isEmpty,\n    filteredProducts,\n    \n    // 方法\n    fetchProducts,\n    fetchProduct,\n    setFilters,\n    clearFilters,\n    setPage\n  }\n})\n```\n\n### 异步操作处理\n\n正确处理异步操作是状态管理的关键部分。\n\n```javascript\n// 异步操作处理最佳实践\nexport const useAsyncStore = defineStore('async', () => {\n  const data = ref(null)\n  const loading = ref(false)\n  const error = ref(null)\n  \n  // 基本异步操作\n  async function fetchData(url) {\n    loading.value = true\n    error.value = null\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(url)\n      \n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`)\n      }\n      \n      data.value = await response.json()\n      return data.value\n    } catch (err) {\n      error.value = err.message\n      console.error('Fetch data error:', err)\n      throw err\n    } finally {\n      loading.value = false\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // 带重试机制的异步操作\n  async function fetchWithRetry(url, maxRetries = 3, delay = 1000) {\n    let lastError\n    \n    for (let i = 0; i < maxRetries; i++) {\n      try {\n        return await fetchData(url)\n      } catch (err) {\n        lastError = err\n        \n        if (i < maxRetries - 1) {\n          console.warn(`Retry ${i + 1}/${maxRetries} after ${delay}ms`)\n          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delay))\n          delay *= 2 // 指数退避\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    \n    throw lastError\n  }\n  \n  // 带取消功能的异步操作\n  let abortController = null\n  \n  async function fetchWithCancel(url) {\n    // 取消之前的请求\n    if (abortController) {\n      abortController.abort()\n    }\n    \n    abortController = new AbortController()\n    \n    loading.value = true\n    error.value = null\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(url, {\n        signal: abortController.signal\n      })\n      \n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`)\n      }\n      \n      data.value = await response.json()\n      return data.value\n    } catch (err) {\n      // 如果是取消操作，不设置错误\n      if (err.name !== 'AbortError') {\n        error.value = err.message\n        console.error('Fetch data error:', err)\n        throw err\n      }\n    } finally {\n      loading.value = false\n    }\n  }\n  \n  function cancelRequest() {\n    if (abortController) {\n      abortController.abort()\n    }\n  }\n  \n  return {\n    data,\n    loading,\n    error,\n    fetchData,\n    fetchWithRetry,\n    fetchWithCancel,\n    cancelRequest\n  }\n})\n```\n\n### 模块化与组合\n\n通过模块化和组合实现复杂的状态管理。\n\n```javascript\n// stores/base.js - 基础store\nexport function createBaseStore(id, options = {}) {\n  return defineStore(id, () => {\n    // 基础状态\n    const loading = ref(false)\n    const error = ref(null)\n    \n    // 基础计算属性\n    const isLoading = computed(() => loading.value)\n    const hasError = computed(() => !!error.value)\n    const errorMessage = computed(() => error.value?.message || '')\n    \n    // 基础方法\n    function setLoading(status) {\n      loading.value = status\n    }\n    \n    function setError(err) {\n      error.value = err\n    }\n    \n    function clearError() {\n      error.value = null\n    }\n    \n    // 通用异步操作包装器\n    async function withLoading(promise) {\n      try {\n        setLoading(true)\n        clearError()\n        return await promise\n      } catch (err) {\n        setError(err)\n        throw err\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false)\n      }\n    }\n    \n    return {\n      loading,\n      error,\n      isLoading,\n      hasError,\n      errorMessage,\n      setLoading,\n      setError,\n      clearError,\n      withLoading\n    }\n  })\n}\n\n// stores/crud.js - CRUD操作\nexport function createCrudStore(id, resourceUrl, options = {}) {\n  const baseStore = createBaseStore(id, options)\n  \n  return defineStore(id, () => {\n    // 使用基础store\n    const { loading, error, isLoading, hasError, errorMessage, setLoading, setError, clearError, withLoading } = baseStore()\n    \n    // 资源状态\n    const items = ref([])\n    const item = ref(null)\n    const pagination = ref({\n      page: 1,\n      limit: 20,\n      total: 0\n    })\n    \n    // 计算属性\n    const hasItems = computed(() => items.value.length > 0)\n    const isEmpty = computed(() => items.value.length === 0)\n    \n    // CRUD方法\n    async function fetchItems(params = {}) {\n      return withLoading(\n        fetch(`${resourceUrl}?${new URLSearchParams(params)}`)\n          .then(response => {\n            if (!response.ok) {\n              throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`)\n            }\n            return response.json()\n          })\n          .then(data => {\n            items.value = data.items\n            pagination.value = data.pagination\n            return data\n          })\n      )\n    }\n    \n    async function fetchItem(id) {\n      return withLoading(\n        fetch(`${resourceUrl}/${id}`)\n          .then(response => {\n            if (!response.ok) {\n              throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`)\n            }\n            return response.json()\n          })\n          .then(data => {\n            item.value = data\n            return data\n          })\n      )\n    }\n    \n    async function createItem(newItem) {\n      return withLoading(\n        fetch(resourceUrl, {\n          method: 'POST',\n          headers: {\n            'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n          },\n          body: JSON.stringify(newItem)\n        })\n          .then(response => {\n            if (!response.ok) {\n              throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`)\n            }\n            return response.json()\n          })\n          .then(data => {\n            items.value.push(data)\n            return data\n          })\n      )\n    }\n    \n    async function updateItem(id, updatedItem) {\n      return withLoading(\n        fetch(`${resourceUrl}/${id}`, {\n          method: 'PUT',\n          headers: {\n            'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n          },\n          body: JSON.stringify(updatedItem)\n        })\n          .then(response => {\n            if (!response.ok) {\n              throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`)\n            }\n            return response.json()\n          })\n          .then(data => {\n            const index = items.value.findIndex(item => item.id === id)\n            if (index !== -1) {\n              items.value[index] = data\n            }\n            if (item.value && item.value.id === id) {\n              item.value = data\n            }\n            return data\n          })\n      )\n    }\n    \n    async function deleteItem(id) {\n      return withLoading(\n        fetch(`${resourceUrl}/${id}`, {\n          method: 'DELETE'\n        })\n          .then(response => {\n            if (!response.ok) {\n              throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`)\n            }\n            return response.json()\n          })\n          .then(() => {\n            items.value = items.value.filter(item => item.id !== id)\n            if (item.value && item.value.id === id) {\n              item.value = null\n            }\n          })\n      )\n    }\n    \n    return {\n      // 状态\n      items,\n      item,\n      pagination,\n      loading,\n      error,\n      \n      // 计算属性\n      isLoading,\n      hasError,\n      errorMessage,\n      hasItems,\n      isEmpty,\n      \n      // 方法\n      fetchItems,\n      fetchItem,\n      createItem,\n      updateItem,\n      deleteItem\n    }\n  })\n}\n\n// 使用示例\nexport const useUserStore = createCrudStore('users', '/api/users')\nexport const useProductStore = createCrudStore('products', '/api/products')\n```\n\n## 总结\n\nPinia作为Vue的新一代状态管理库，提供了简洁、直观且功能强大的API，使状态管理变得更加容易和高效。\n\n### Pinia的优势\n\n1. **简洁的API**：减少了模板代码，提供了更直观的开发体验\n2. **优秀的TypeScript支持**：无需额外配置即可获得完整的类型推断\n3. **模块化设计**：每个store都是独立的，天然支持模块化\n4. **灵活的状态更新**：支持直接修改状态，无需mutation\n5. **强大的插件系统**：可以轻松扩展store的功能\n6. **出色的开发体验**：提供了更好的调试支持和错误处理\n\n### 实际开发建议\n\n1. **合理设计状态结构**：使用实体-ID模式，避免数据冗余\n2. **正确处理异步操作**：使用loading和error状态，提供良好的用户体验\n3. **模块化和组合**：创建可复用的store逻辑，提高代码复用性\n4. **利用TypeScript**：定义清晰的接口，提高代码可维护性\n5. **持久化关键状态**：使用localStorage或sessionStorage保存重要状态\n6. **合理使用插件**：根据需要创建自定义插件，扩展store功能\n\n通过合理使用Pinia，我们可以构建出状态管理清晰、代码可维护性高、用户体验良好的Vue应用程序。"
